title: Kahran & Divya on Continuing Projects
summary: Two years into the podcast, Divya picks up on Kahran's growing ambivalence and they talk it through in real time — why a long-running project's value shifts, the difference between approaching work as play versus duty, and what makes the conversations still worth showing up for. They end up landing on play, curiosity and disappointment as more useful framings than success or output.

intents.display: to hear cofounders work through ambivalence about a long-running project
